title: SpaceX Used One Pad Twice In 32 Hours

sentences.text: Thirty-two hours. That pad was not done.
sentences.caption: That pad was not done

sentences.text: Friday night a Falcon 9 left Vandenberg.
sentences.caption: Friday night at Vandenberg

sentences.text: Sunday morning another Falcon 9 left the same pad.
sentences.caption: Same pad Sunday morning

sentences.text: The gap was 32 hours, 3 minutes and 21 seconds.
sentences.caption: 32 hours 3 minutes 21 seconds

sentences.text: The old record was 45 hours, from Florida.
sentences.caption: Old record was 45 hours

sentences.text: It beat this pad's old mark by more than 23 hours.
sentences.caption: More than 23 hours faster

sentences.text: These were two boosters, not one.
sentences.caption: Two boosters not one

sentences.text: The second, B1097, was flying for the fourteenth time.
sentences.caption: B1097 on flight 14

sentences.text: It landed back at Vandenberg seven and a half minutes later.
sentences.caption: Landed 7.5 minutes later

sentences.text: SpaceX's launch chief still wants a 24-hour turn.
sentences.caption: Next goal is 24 hours

sentences.text: That turn has not happened yet.
sentences.caption: That turn has not happened
